# Compact assignment completion contract

Embed in each substantive future brief; use proportionate detail for risk/scope.
Do not allocate IDs or claim approval from this blank template.

- Task type: discovery / research hypothesis / deterministic reconstruction /
  engineering implementation / integration / audit / documentation.
- Question / deliverable: <concrete claim, model, code or artifact>.
- Controlling questions: <stable IDs; original question, success/falsification
  conditions and required generality; parent ID/status for a bounded subtask>.
- Active investigation ledger: <path created near the start; hypotheses,
  boundaries, checked paths/evidence, counterexamples, dependencies, viable leads,
  failed alternatives and each branch disposition/next action/reproduction>.
- Scope / bounds: <allowed actions and inputs; protected inputs; prohibited
  operations; live/external permissions; applicable disk/output/exit guards>.
- Mandatory acceptance: <numbered observable criteria and primary evidence;
  independent oracle where actually required; required independent review>.
  For D5AL and future newly issued briefs, required reading is complete relevant
  coverage by final substantive acceptance, with recorded application and
  independent verification; reading order is not an AC01 criterion. Missing
  critical content, material misunderstanding or unverifiable coverage fails.
  Historical contracts and breaches remain unchanged.
- Optional acceptance: <clearly separate improvements>.
- Negative-result closure: <adequate scoped falsification/absence evidence;
  controls and limitations; engineering abandonment review if applicable>.
- Continuation authority: investigate, correct, refactor, retest and requalify
  in scope under this assignment; no new brief for ordinary failed tests.
- Exit / escalation: <exact safety/authority/resource limits; evidence to retain;
  narrow request and resume checkpoint>.
  Apply [scientific experiment continuation and health](../../WORKFLOW.md#scientific-experiment-continuation-and-health): no automatic time/volume/operator-delay/cadence cutoff for a healthy run; justify essential additional hard limits and obtain maintainer approval before live execution. Preserve both-drive free-space and all integrity/identity/worker/STOP controls, and historical criteria/results.
- Question-level terminal proof: <COMPLETE answer meeting original criteria, or
  BLOCKED with exact missing indispensable edge/input/action, attempts/evidence,
  alternatives/residual impact, barrier class, smallest needed permission or
  capability and resume checkpoint>. Otherwise INCOMPLETE / REWORK. Pursue material
  authorized dependencies across subsystem boundaries; a method NO-GO leaves the
  parent open and does not excuse viable routes in this assignment.
- Completeness challenge: <reviewer gets original contract/amendments, active
  ledger, primary evidence/negative controls, current tree and claims; challenges
  every material branch and identifies highest-value omitted avenue or evidence
  none remains>. COMPLETE alone is eligible for ACCEPT; BLOCKED maps to ESCALATE.
- Review artifacts / disposition: acceptance matrix, primary evidence ledger,
  failed/regression cases, status/inclusion/exclusion inventories, verified
  complete/task-only diffs, separate outcome dimensions, reviewer decision.
- Editorial finalization: follow [the standard](../EDITORIAL_STANDARD.md), record
  screening and complete manual coverage, obtain independent exact-final-prose
  review, and verify snapshot/export identity; review substantive later deltas.

Freeze mandatory criteria for acceptance. Record maintainer-approved material
amendments with original criteria, date and reason. Apply the
[protocol](../RESEARCH_EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md) and existing permission gates.
